title.zh: 卡 A-1a：NP5-01a mass_solve factor 半段 source 级逐站点对照（40 站点；类型映射 + 表达式分类；零 GPU）
title.en: Card A-1a: NP5-01a source-level per-site comparison for the mass_solve factor half (40 sites; type mapping + expression classification; zero GPU)

intent.zh: 按 Chief 2026-11-11 18:00 指令：用 target 预热草稿（A-1-split.json / A-1a 40 站点）+ 7 步校准法（P1 exact → P2 token 稳定 → P3 resident 派生），落 docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-a1a/：每站点给 source 级类型映射 + 表达式分类（六类词表含 n/a，`recipe-difference` 带 value_equivalent/value_equivalence_basis，`not-decidable` 带 6 类 not_decidable_reasons[]）+ 双侧 file:line；自检 40 站点 / pending=0 / 词表合法 / 无通过率表述。覆盖：rigid_mass_solve factor 类 13 + resident_mass_factor 4 + sparse_mass_copy/update/diag 7 + small_prefix_* 8 + mixed_factor_merge 2 + sparse_dense_validate/gather 3 + rounding-note 0/2/3 3。零 GPU、零窗；不改 src/tests/fixtures/scripts、判据/参考/容差。
intent.en: Per Chief's 18:00 instruction: use the target prewarm draft (A-1-split.json, A-1a = 40 sites) and the 7-step calibration to land docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-a1a/: per-site source-level type mapping + expression classification (6-category vocabulary incl n/a; recipe-difference with value_equivalent/value_equivalence_basis; not-decidable with the 6-item not_decidable_reasons list) and file:line on both sides; self-check 40 sites / pending=0 / legal vocabulary / no coverage-rate statements. Zero GPU/window; no src/tests/fixtures/scripts, criteria/reference/tolerance changes.

acceptance: `docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-a1a/evidence.json`：40 站点（与 `np5-01a/A-1-draft/A-1-split.json` 的 A-1a 列表逐 id 一致），每站点含 id/kind/label/product_anchor(file:line)/reference_anchor(file:line 或明确 no-reference-entry)/type_mapping/classification/五项必填字段。

分类只用六类词表（identical / pin-needed / recipe-difference / engine-semantic / not-decidable / n/a）；`recipe-difference` 必带 `value_equivalent: true` + `value_equivalence_basis: "analytic, not bit-tested"`；`not-decidable` 必带 6 类 `not_decidable_reasons[]` 且缺项逐条写「缺什么证据才能升级」；**不写覆盖率/通过率**。
`README.md`：范围/方法（7 步法）/分类判据说明/逐组统计（不含通过率）/判断说明与待复核项/非声明（不宣称 NP01 通过、不作位级等价、零 GPU）。
`receipt.json`：sites_total=40、pending_manual=0、分类计数、inputs（spec sha、field-table sha、upstream 71da24d9…）、tree.head、gates；`manifest.txt` 逐条 sha256+bytes 自核（不自列）；UTF-8/LF/无 BOM。
自检脚本输出（`logs/selfcheck.txt`）：40/40 id 一致、pending=0、词表合法、必填字段齐全、理由码合法、无未加否定的通过类表述。
边界：写域仅 `docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-a1a/**` + `.normify/**`；`unchanged src/`、`tests/`、`fixtures/`、`scripts/`；不改判据/参考/容差/场表；零 GPU、零窗。
四门禁 fmt/clippy/clippy-cuda/unit + `normify check`；中文提交。
note: Chief 2026-11-11 18:00 GO；依据 NP5-01a-SLICE-PLAN.md A-1a + target 草稿 A-1-split.json；词表以 np5-01a-vocab-addendum.md 为准；QA 18:00 后可核。
